o.text: From Proto-Turkic *öŋ, *oŋ. Cognate with Old Turkic [script needed] (öŋ, “front, face”).

From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (görkäm, “worth seeing, flashy, beautiful”, adjective), Old Anatolian Turkish [Term?] (“görk”). Related to görmək (“to see”).
Compare Turkish görkem.
From qolay + -lan. Perhaps from the dialectal sense of qolay 'direction, way, side'.
